capabilities: Play audio and video files from a watched folder with resume and auto-play next
Keep queue state and playback progress in sync across desktop and mobile
Manage the queue with sorting, drag-and-drop reordering, and progress indicators
Download YouTube videos or audio via yt-dlp with quality options
Delete completed files and warn when a storage limit is exceeded
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. YouTube downloading is desktop-only; Android users are directed to Seal instead.
motivation: Created for personal productivity and cross-device media consumption.
problem: Obsidian can embed media files but has no managed player with a queue, resume, progress tracking, or playback that continues across devices.

relations.evidence: Download videos or audio directly from YouTube using yt-dlp.
you should use Seal for downloading YouTube videos, as this feature does not work on mobile

summary: Media player plugin that watches a folder, queues audio and video files, and keeps playback position in sync across desktop and mobile.
